summary: National Fuel Gas completed its previously announced acquisition of CenterPoint Ohio, the Ohio local gas distribution business of CenterPoint Energy Resources, for a $2.62 billion aggregate purchase price subject to customary adjustments, effective October 1, 2026. Consideration comprised $1.42 billion cash plus a $1.20 billion unsecured seller promissory note. The note, dated October 1, 2026, matures September 30, 2027 and bears 6.5% interest, with a 0.65 debt-to-capitalization covenant. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed in the excerpt. Watch integration execution, financing costs, and regulatory outcomes.
